queries_run: Grab Holdings tariff OR export control OR trade restriction 2026

findings.claim: 20-F 列出在東南亞營運的風險包含新增或更繁重的法規、稅負或關稅；另揭露受緬甸相關制裁（含敏感品項出口／再出口限制），緬甸營運占營收不到 1%。
findings.excerpt: While our operations in Myanmar represent less than one percent of our revenue, our future prospects there could be adversely affected, potentially necessitating a market exit involving significant costs and the loss of our investment.

findings.claim: 20-F 風險因子列「new or more burdensome regulations, taxes, or tariffs」為東南亞營運風險之一。
findings.excerpt: •new or more burdensome regulations, taxes, or tariffs;

reg_tariff_export.note: 搜尋僅一次，未查到 2026 針對 Grab 的關稅或出口管制新聞；服務型平台業務，僅有 20-F 一般性揭露。
